hypotheses.title: Triple-bottom hold + gap-day-high reclaim long

hypotheses.problem_target: Avoid buying the falling knife while still capturing the oversold reversal

hypotheses.expected_impact: R:R ~1.5-1.8 to gap zone with defined invalidation
key_risks: Negative PEAD can grind lower for weeks
Gap-fill zone 314-320 is heavy overhead supply
kill_criteria: No trigger within 10 sessions (by 2026-11-13) -> cancel order
Weekly close below 271 -> thesis invalid, revert to IDEA/park
hypotheses.rationale: Clear invalidation level, waits for confirmation instead of guessing the bottom.
